statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low at 4 because CME equity index futures have been halted since 21:00Z Friday and no tradable Nasdaq-100 price path exists inside any hour of this 24-hour horizon; Stress is 42, moderate, as a 50% US tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian goods is now in force against a pledged dollar-for-dollar match, the 21 August curve prints at 4.19% on the 2-year, 4.69% on the 10-year and 5.23% on the 30-year with the long bond at its highest since 2007, crude closes a second consecutive weekly gain of roughly 5%, and a week carrying July PCE, Nvidia results and the Jackson Hole symposium waits on the other side of the halt; Confidence is 88 because the closing session, curve, volatility, energy and calendar evidence is verified and precise, and the only missing input is a live price path that cannot exist while the venue is shut.
recommendation: The last observed session remains consistent with functioning mean reversion: cash NDX traded down to 29,142.44, reclaimed the whole decline to 29,405.12, closed at 29,308.86 below its own 29,359.60 open, and left VIX at 14.89 near the session low as the August expiry cleared without one-way extension. Both extremes were retraced and neither produced repeated extension after a failed pullback, so none of the observed amplifiers that normally lift Tail above the block threshold are present. The venue has been shut since 21:00Z Friday and reopens Sunday at 22:00Z, roughly eight hours beyond the final slot published here, so every forward hour describes a closed market rather than a forecast price path. Weekend headline accumulation is real and is carried in Stress: tariffs in force with a matched Canadian response promised, a 30-year yield at its highest since 2007, a standing energy premium and a dense event week. Tail reflects the absence of a tradable path, not the absence of risk, and the first evidence about how these headlines are absorbed will arrive only after this horizon expires.
headline: Closed-venue assessment: CME equity index futures stay halted across all twenty-four published hours while a 50% US tariff on about $20bn of Canadian goods meets a pledged dollar-for-dollar match, a 30-year yield at its highest since 2007 sits unpriced, and Tail holds the closed-venue floor of 4.
body: CME equity index futures stopped trading for the week at 21:00Z on Friday and reopen on Sunday at 22:00Z, so the venue is confirmed shut across all twenty-four slots published here, which run from 2026-08-22T14:00:00Z to 2026-08-23T13:00:00Z and end about eight hours before the reopen. Cash NDX settled at 29,308.86, up 95.69 points or 0.33% from a 29,213.17 previous close, after opening at 29,359.60, trading down to 29,142.44, reclaiming the entire decline to 29,405.12 and then handing back roughly ninety-six points to finish below its own open. Both extremes were retraced and neither produced repeated extension after a failed pullback, which is the observed profile of a functioning two-sided market rather than a pathological one-way path. The wider week was harder: the Nasdaq lost about 2% and the S&P 500 about 1.4%, leaving the broad index roughly 2% below its record high, and the move was driven by Treasury volatility rather than by equity news. The Federal Reserve's H.15 release now carries Friday's curve at 4.19% on the 2-year, 4.69% on the 10-year and 5.23% on the 30-year, with the long bond reported at its highest yield since 2007. The rates move reached the index mainly through semiconductors, where the Philadelphia chips gauge fell about 5% on the week. VIX closed at 14.89, down 6.00%, near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range on August expiry day. Cross-asset evidence from that session was conflicted rather than aligned: equities firmer, volatility lower, gold sharply higher and the long end weaker at the same time, with five of eight megacaps up on dispersion of about 1.82 points while the semiconductor group stayed mixed at three higher out of seven. Conflict of that kind weighs on Stress and on directional conviction, not on Tail. Weekend items have accumulated with no venue able to absorb them. The 50% US tariff took effect at 12:01 a.m. ET on roughly $20 billion of Canadian goods, about 5% of what Canada ships south, Ottawa suspended negotiations and pledged a dollar-for-dollar match. Energy remains the most persistent input, with WTI near $87.06 and Brent near $94.39 completing a second consecutive weekly gain of roughly 5% while Strait of Hormuz transit stays disrupted. One offset is already announced rather than hypothetical: the Treasury will roughly double its liquidity-support buybacks in the 10- to 30-year sector from 9 September until at least 4 November, well beyond this horizon. The week ahead is dense: July PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and July durable goods all print together at 12:30Z on Wednesday, Nvidia reports after the US close the same day, and the Jackson Hole symposium runs 27-29 August with the Fed Chair keynote scheduled for Friday at 14:00Z. All of that is scheduled position rather than observed outcome, so it is recorded in the event calendar and carried in Stress. Tail holds the closed-venue floor of 4 in every slot because a price path cannot be pathological when no price path can form, and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON with no danger window, since a narrow evidence-based window cannot be drawn around a market that is not open. Shared Finviz cross-asset context collected at 14:03Z was fresh and complete and is used only as delayed latest-session confirmation of that mixed internal picture, never as live price-path evidence.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past 24 hours is close to complete: 22 hourly assessments are available, while the 05:00Z and 06:00Z clock-hours on 22 August have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. Across the available hours Tail held a narrow 4-16 band and the mapped policy state stayed EA_ON throughout, so no hour approached the block threshold. The path tracks the session that produced it: 16 and 14 through the US cash open and the early afternoon of 21 August with an event/whipsaw reading during that repricing, a fade to 13 through the middle of the US session, a brief lift to 16 into the expiry close, then 10 at 20:00Z and 5 at 21:00Z as the venue shut. Every hour since has sat at the closed-venue floor of 4 with a normal dominant mode. Stress traced the mirror image, easing from 58 at the start of the window to 35 in the small hours of 22 August before firming back to 42 by 13:00Z as tariff, rates and energy headlines accumulated with no market able to price them. Confidence stayed in the 84-88 band throughout.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 4 because CME equity index futures are confirmed halted and no Nasdaq-100 price path can develop inside this slot. All twenty-three remaining slots describe the same closed market: the final slot begins at 2026-08-23T13:00:00Z and ends roughly eight hours before the Sunday 22:00Z reopen, so no live evidence can arrive before this forecast expires. Tail therefore holds the closed-venue floor of 4 in every hour and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON throughout, which reflects the absence of a tradable path rather than an absence of risk. Stress does the work instead. It starts at 42, eases to 39 through the thinning Saturday evening and the European overnight, then firms steadily to 43 in the final slots as the horizon closes on a week carrying July PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and July durable goods together at 12:30Z on Wednesday, Nvidia results after the US close the same day, coupon supply on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and the Jackson Hole symposium from 27 to 29 August with the Fed Chair keynote on Friday at 14:00Z. That firming is calendar arithmetic and unpriced headline accumulation, not observed alignment. Confidence decays gently from 88 to 82 as the last live observation ages past a day and a half, which is ordinary staleness for a closed weekend rather than conflict between sources. Every forward slot is framed conditionally by construction, and the first genuine test of how the tariff, rates and energy stack is absorbed belongs to the sessions that can observe it.
